about: Measurement set for the end of a retired stay (proposed): plans tied to a bounded stay, leave or freeze that an update retired, beside non-dependent controls. Same shape as cases.json, so the re-anchor probe and second reading run over it unchanged. 'expected' is DEPENDS when the claim, read as a statement about now, relied on the retired circumstance being current, else HOLDS. Each candidate's 'form' names what it measures. end-of-stay: the claim states how the retired circumstance ends (a return, a last day, a check-out, the departure or reopening that ends it), with no relative or possessive reference and no definite description of the retired thing, which is the form the current rubric does not name. kind-a / kind-b: a reference the current rubric already names, so these pin that the new rule does not regress them. control-*: a HOLDS claim built to tempt an over-broad reading of the end-of-stay form (plan-at-origin: a plan at the place the stay returns to; plan-during: a plan at the stay's place within it; other-person: someone else's travel; later-visit: a later trip that uses the word 'back'; stay-start or past-event: a dated event that already happened; world-knowledge: a plan a reader would expect to change with the circumstance though nothing in the claim or passage ties it to the end; pegged-event: the event the circumstance is pegged to, not its end; lasting / place / residence / dated-request as in cases.json). 'retired_by' is the update that retired the claim, for the labeller only: the probe is never shown it. 'restates_limit' marks an end-of-stay candidate that restates the limit the retired claim itself states (its last day, its end date), which the paraphrase route may retire by update before the re-anchor pass sees it. Either route passes (owner's ruling), and results are reported for these apart. The baseline under the current prompts is recorded with the proposal. The runner reads cases.json only, so until it takes a fixture path, run this file by pointing scripts/reanchor_fixture.py's FIXTURE at it from a scratch wrapper (one probe per case, one reading per DEPENDS verdict).
labelled_by: proposed by the drafting session. The owner confirmed every label as proposed on 2026-10-11, after the baseline and the review brief (the dentist appointment, the brief's boundary case, stays HOLDS). The trip-return-flight case uses the claims and passage of tests/fixtures/trip_vs_move/ session 11: the first candidate is the phrasing extracted on the 2026-10-10 acceptance run, which the probe judged HOLDS, the second the 1.178.1 phrasing, which the 2026-10-09 replay judged DEPENDS 2 of 2, and the hotel claim was re-anchored on 1.178.1.
